scenes.name: A CLOSED SPECTRUM
lines: On an open line, Fourier analysis needs pi, e, and a continuum of frequencies.
在敞开的直线上，傅里叶分析离不开 π、e 和连续不断的频率。
Close it into the three-sphere of unit quaternions, and waves must meet themselves.
把它闭合成单位四元数构成的三维球面，波就必须首尾咬合。
By Peter Weyl, the spectrum becomes spin shells, each holding two j plus one, squared, functions.
由彼得—魏尔定理，频谱化为一级级自旋壳，第 j 壳携带 (2j + 1)² 个函数。
Lean checks the backbone: on any compact group, finite unitary matrix entries are dense.
Lean 内核检验其骨架：在任意紧群上，有限维幺正表示的矩阵元一致稠密。

scenes.name: THREE FIRST SHELLS
lines: Compare p with the anchor one: kappa is w squared over its squared norm.
把四元数 p 与锚点 1 比较：保真度 κ 等于 w² 除以模方。
The first three shells read one, four kappa for the squared spinor, and four kappa minus one.
前三座壳层读作 1、旋量平方核 4κ，以及 4κ − 1。
The book reads them as past, present and future: a model reading, not a theorem.
书中把它们读作过去、现在与未来：这是模型诠释，不是定理。
One identity welds them: four kappa is one plus four kappa minus one, as two times two is one plus three.
一条恒等式把它们焊在一起：4κ = 1 + (4κ − 1)，正如 2 × 2 = 1 + 3。
At the integer rotor one, one, one, one, kappa is a quarter and spin one reads zero.
在整数旋子 (1, 1, 1, 1) 处，κ = 1/4，自旋 1 读数恰为 0。

scenes.name: NO SQUARE ROOTS
lines: Characters are Chebyshev polynomials in c, the real part, and c is the square root of kappa.
特征标是关于实部 c 的切比雪夫多项式，而 c 是 κ 的平方根。
For whole spins, multiply by four kappa minus two and subtract the shell before.
对整数自旋，每次乘以 4κ − 2，再减去前一座壳。
Lean checks over the integers that E n of x squared is U two n of x.
Lean 内核在整数上检验：Eₙ(x²) = U₂ₙ(x)，平方根全部消去。
Spin two, then, is sixteen kappa squared minus twelve kappa plus one.
于是自旋 2 就是 16κ² − 12κ + 1。

scenes.name: RATIONAL LANDMARKS
lines: On six rational landmarks, every whole-spin character is an exact fraction.
在六个有理地标上，每个整数自旋特征标都是精确分数（屏幕计算）。
At kappa one they read one, three, five, seven; at one third, spin two is minus eleven ninths.
Half spins keep a single factor of c, Lean checks, times a polynomial in kappa.
Lean 内核检验：半整数自旋恰保留一个因子 c，再乘一个关于 κ 的多项式。
Its sign flips with q; for p one, one, zero, zero, it has size root two.
它的符号随 q 翻转：取 p = (1, 1, 0, 0)，旋量特征标的大小是 √2。

scenes.name: SHELL FUSION
lines: Shells also multiply, into a run from their gap up to their sum.
壳层还能相乘，乘积是从两者之差到两者之和的一串壳。
Spin one times spin two gives one, two and three: three times five is three plus five plus seven.
Both sides are sixty-four kappa cubed, minus sixty-four kappa squared, plus sixteen kappa, minus one.
两边都展开为 64κ³ − 64κ² + 16κ − 1。
Lean checks this rule for every pair m and n.
Lean 内核对每一对 m、n 检验这条融合律。

scenes.name: NO ORIGIN
lines: Convolution usually needs an origin; the heap bracket y, x bar, w needs none.
卷积通常需要原点；流群括号 y x̄ w 一个都不需要。
Along it, each shell turns the convolution into three matrices multiplied: a written derivation.
沿它求平均，卷积在每座壳上化为三个矩阵相乘：这是书面推导。

scenes.name: SPIN-TWO TESTBED
lines: Spin two has a laboratory: the five d orbitals of gold.
自旋 2 有现成的实验台：金的五条 d 轨道。
Each quadrupole entry is a fraction over seven, computed here; every column sums to zero.
每个四极元都是分母为 7 的分数（屏幕计算），每一列之和都是零。
Lean checks that the closed d ten shell vanishes on every axis.
Lean 内核检验：d¹⁰ 闭壳在每条轴上都归零。
Empty the x squared minus y squared orbital, as in d eight gold: minus four, minus four, plus eight sevenths.
抽空 x² − y² 轨道，如 d⁸ 金那样：−4/7、−4/7、+8/7。

scenes.name: LEDGER
lines: Omega Math, chapter ten.
《OMEGA MATH》· 第十章
